sharedPrompt: Create a realistic editorial food photograph for a Russian home-cooking recipe catalog. Landscape 3:2 composition. One ordinary ceramic soup bowl, fully visible and centered with generous margin, on a light neutral kitchen table. Soft natural window light, accurate food colors and appetizing real texture, slightly elevated three-quarter camera angle. Food is the main subject and clearly inspectable; no people, hands, text, logos, watermark, extra side dishes, cutlery covering food, or raw ingredients scattered around. Not a collage. Depict only the cooked dish described below, without adding unlisted garnishes or ingredients.
